description: Spatiotemporal Distribution Dataset of Photovoltaic Power in China's Tidal Flats, 2010-2024 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Rongjie Liu. Using a novel tidal flat PV detection methodology TFPV-Net based on the improved Swin Transformer network established methodology, and long-term satellite data, the spatiotemporal distribution patterns of China's tidal flat PV installations were characterized. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
